newsitem.title: USA: RTW backs analysts' earnings estimates.
newsitem.headline: RTW backs analysts' earnings estimates.

text.p: RTW Inc Chairman David Prosser said Wednesday the company agreed with the First Call consensus estimate that it would earn $0.21 per share in the third quarter and $0.81 in the full year.

"We haven't sued anybody for overstating where we think it should be. Our history has been to exceed estimates by a penny, but we don't have any problem with the forecasts," Prosser told Reuters after a Dain Bosworth conference in Minneapolis.
To be sure, pricing pressures had surfaced in the workers' compensation market, said Prosser. RTW is a Minneapolis-based workers' compensation insurance and management company.

"There is some pressure on price, no question. Because of the law changes, the big insurers who had left the market are coming back in, and they try to get market share by pushing heavily on the price," he said.

Prosser said the company may open new offices next year. "We have the opportunity of going to Boston, Philadelphia or Chicago, and we haven't chosen which two or three we're going to go into next year, subject to change," he said.
RTW currently has offices in Minnesota, Colorado and Missouri. It will open an office in Michigan next year.
